description: The collaborating Spanish research teams publish 15,070 road-traffic images from a regional Spanish sample, captured from unmanned aerial vehicles for machine-vision training. The describing article documents image acquisition, vehicle annotation, anonymisation and a baseline neural-network check. Zenodo hosts the named dataset as several compressed files under CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse, and the repository points to a Kaggle mirror. The images can help derive traffic counts or evaluate observation systems supplying road-network simulations. UAV viewpoints and the sampled Spanish scenes are a limitation for transfer to fixed roadside cameras or other traffic conditions. Image files and model performance were not independently tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified. The version and concept DOI refer to the same dataset family.
name: Traffic images captured from UAVs for use in training Machine Vision Algorithms for traffic management
notes: G4-0452; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
